```{=html}
<div class="cdb-loading" id="cdb-loading">
  <div class="cdb-spinner"></div>
  Loading data — the first load can take a few seconds…
</div>
```

```{ojs spinner-helper}
//| output: false
// call once the first visualization has rendered
clear_loading = () => document.getElementById("cdb-loading")?.remove()
```
